summary: Corrects account, organization and dashboard feedback, accessibility, spacing and Carbon component patterns.
userImpact: Verification and recovery screens report consistent outcomes and offer direct recovery.
Account and organization workflows use readable content themes, defined spacing and typography, and consistent keyboard and landmark semantics.
Dashboard filters use explicit labels and failed data can be retried locally while retaining available results.
Public sign-in, verification and account-recovery pages retain their dark illustrated layout when using the shared workspace header.
Email-verification feedback, countdown and recovery actions use aligned responsive Carbon grid rows with consistent spacing.

changes: Plugin API 0.6 adds optional host-owned Carbon Checkbox, NumberInput, RadioButton and RadioButtonGroup components; modules feature-detect support.

security: Public verification feedback and keyboard semantics are corrected without changing authentication or organization-membership enforcement.
documentation: docs/development/carbon-component-contracts.md documents theme boundaries, keyboard selection, dashboard states and the optional Carbon component contract.
rollback: Redeploy the previous compatible frontend package or application image.
validation: Frontend unit coverage, affected authentication and dashboard browser journeys, and Chromium/Firefox organization workflows pass.
Frontend host and production builds, frontend typecheck, bundle budget, changed-source lint, and 44 plugin-bridge checks pass.
Current and next plugin API fixtures, published-package version discipline, documentation boundaries, CI contracts, change-detection contracts, and release-note preflight pass.
Twelve rendered verification state/viewport checks confirm shared grid edges, 24px countdown spacing, dark appearance and no horizontal overflow.
The Cloud module passes 367 related tests and 67 browser checks; actual host/module integration verifies the new host-owned controls and content integrity.

customerDocumentation.reason: Existing account, organization and dashboard workflows receive feedback and accessibility corrections; no administrator configuration changes.
